name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Advisory & Technical Systems Professional
summary: B2B advisory professional with 15+ years bridging business needs and technical execution across SaaS, CRM, and marketing-automation systems. Builds and troubleshoots technical integrations (APIs, automation workflows, custom code steps) and advises client leadership on system architecture and adoption as a trusted advisor. Translates ambiguous business intent into structured technical requirements and AI-driven system design, and creates technical thought-leadership content for B2B audiences.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, bridging business intent and reliable LLM output.
Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.

bullets: Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria for the team building it.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

bullets: Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
